content: Zaallafe Pultida Haathe
Koyro ageenan Isra7eele asa ubbay Siina mela biitta gakidi, Qaadesa geetetiya bessan dunkaanidosona. Mayraama yan hayqada moogetasu.
He bessan asaas haathi dhayin, asay Muse bollanne Aarona bolla dendidosona.
Enti, “Nu ishati Godaa sinthan hayqida wode nuka hayqida gidorkoshin.
Nunne nu mehey ha mela biittan hayqana mela Godaa maabara ha bessa ayis ehidetii?
Gibxefe kessidi ha iita bessaa nuna ayis ehidetii? Haysan kathi woyko balasey woyko woyney woyko oromaaney baawa; hari attoshin uyetiya haathika haysan baawa” yaagidi Musera kacetidosona.
Yaatin Museynne Aaroni asaa matape geeshsha dunkaaniya penge bidi sa7an gufannidosona; Godaa bonchoyka entaw qoncis.
Goday Museko,
“Ne xam7a eka; neeranne ne ishaa Aaronara maabara shiishite. Enta sinthan zaallay haathe kessana mela oda. Hinte zaallafe haathe kessidi, entanne enta mehiya ushshana” yaagis.
Goday kiitidaysada Musey Godaa sinthafe xam7aa ekis.
Museynne Aaroni maabara zaalla sinthan shiiqana mela oothidi, asaako, “Hinteno geellato, si7ite; ha zaallafe hintew nuuni tuma haathe kessanee?” yaagis.
Musey ba xam7a denthidi zaalla nam7u toho shocis; haathi dhuuqidi keyin entinne enta meheti uyidosona.
Shin Goday Musekonne Aaronako, “Isra7eele asaa sinthan hinte ta geeshshatetha bessanaw ammanetibona gisho ta entaw immiya biitta ha asaa kaalethidi hinte geleketa” yaagis.
Isra7eele asay Godaara kacetida gishonne Goday ba geeshshatetha enta giddon qoncisida gisho he bessay Mariba
haatha geetetis.
Isra7eeleti Edoomera Aadhethi Digetidosona
Edoome kawako Musey Qaadesape haysada yaagidi kiita yeddis. “Ne ishay Isra7eeley haysada yaagees; nuna gakida meto ubbaa ne si7adasa.
Nu mayzati duge Gibxe wodhidosona; yan nuuni daro laythi de7ida. Gibxeti nunanne nu aawata un7ethidosona.
Nuuni Godaako waassin, I nu waasuwa si7idi, ba kiitanchuwa Kiitidi nuna Gibxefe kessis. Ha77i nuuni ne biitta gaxan de7iya Qaadesa kataman de7oos.

Hayyana, nuuni ne biittaara kanthidi aadhana mela ootharki; nuuni ogepe gaxa keyoko; ne goshsha woyko woyne gade giddo geloko; nuuni haatha ollafe haathe uyoko. Nuuni kawo oge oykidi baana; nuuni ne biittara kanthidi aadhana gakanaw haddirsi woyko ushachi gooko” yaagis.
Shin Edoome asay, “Nu biittaara kanthisoko; hinte haysara kanthanaw qopiko, nuuni dendidi hintena olana” yaagidosona.
Yaatin Isra7eele asay, “Nuuni kawo ogiyara baana; nuuni woyko nu mehey hinte haathaafe uyiko, nuuni hessas gate ciggana; nuuni tohora aadhetha xalaala koyoos; haraba aykoka koyoko” yaagidosona.
Edoome asay zaaridi, “Hinte haysara aadhanaw danda7eketa” yaagis. Kaallidi, daronne wolqaama olanchota ekidi Isra7eele asaa olanaw keyis.
Edoome asay banta biittara Isra7eele asaa aathona ixin, Isra7eele asay simmidi hara ogera bidosona.
Isra7eele asa ubbay Qaadesape dendidi Hoora zumako bidosona.
Edoome zawan de7iya Hoora zuman, Goday Musekonne Aaronako,
“Aaroni ba mayzatan gahetiya wodey gakis. Hinte nam7ay Mariba haatha matan ta kiitaa bolla geellatida gisho Isra7eele asaas ta immiya biitta I gelenna.
Aaronanne iya na7aa Alaazara ekada Hoora zuma bolla keya.
Aarona kahinetetha ma7uwa qaarada, iya na7aa Alaazara mayza. Aaroni yan hayqana” yaagis.
Goday kiitidaysada Musey oothis; Isra7eele asa ubbay be7ishin, enti Hoora zuma bolla keyidosona.
Musey Aarona kahinetetha ma7uwa qaaridi iya na7aa Alaazara mayzis. Aaroni he zuma huuphen hayqis. Museynne Alaazari zumaape wodhidosona.
Aaroni hayqidaysa Isra7eele asay erida wode Isra7eele asay Aaronas hastamu gallas yeekidosona.
